name: Youth service information sharing
description: Describes the information sharing arrangements between Work and Income and Youth Service providers (NEET and Payment), including third party agencies and organisations sharing information about young people involved in youth services.

attributes.summary: Covers the bidirectional sharing of information between Work and Income and Youth Service (NEET and Payment) providers, as well as third party information sharing about young persons, including a list of covered third party agencies and organisations.
